name: Mushrooms under Glass II
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Cream the butter, add lemon juice drop by drop, salt, pepper, and parsley.
Cut bread in circular pieces three-eighths inch thick, then toast.
Put one-half of the sauce on the under side of toast; put toast on a small baking-dish, pile mushroom caps cleaned and peeled in conical shape on toast, and pour over cream.
Cover with glass and bake about twenty-five minutes, adding more cream if necessary.
Just before serving add one teaspoon Sherry wine.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
